name: Mitsui O.S.K. Lines, Ltd.
summary: Mitsui O.S.K. Lines, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides maritime cargo transport and ship chartering services in Japan, North America, Europe, Singapore, and internationally. It operates through Dry Bulk Business; Energy Business; Container Ship Business; Automobile Transport, Port, and Logistics Business; Ferry/Domestic RORO Ship Business/Cruise Business; Real Estate Business; and Related Businesses segments.
